samples.design_finding: The causal/resource-state consequence is visible in data and sampled footage; this is materially different from a pure walking junction. It is still not a complete demonstration of meaningful pre-commit resource allocation.

issues.finding: At initial decision, default camera shows only east high destination while west reward is off-screen, and east reward is partly covered by topUI. A player cannot compare two destinations from the shown entry view.
issues.falsifiable_repair: Reframe entry or recompose actual geometry so both high destinations, enemy and first relevant staged supports are visible before commitment; keep physics unchanged for presentation-only repair.

issues.finding: This single clip chooses east-air then intentionally spends the final enemyHP before west-staged. It does not show a1HP-only air attempt versus conserving thatHP and using staged route, or the opposite allocation order.
issues.falsifiable_repair: Provide matched world-state policies/route-cost table for opposite resource allocations and enemy-exhausted recovery, keeping reward/exit outcomes explicit.

issues.finding: Both rewards are12 coins and banks are similar; east is closer. Whether there are meaningful reasons to spend scarce hits on the west route is not established. Different port names are not evidence of different benefits.
issues.falsifiable_repair: Compare air versus staged costs/risk for both destinations and actual intended onward use; do not add arbitrary decoration or inflate reward just to pass a checklist.

issues.finding: Geometry in sampled footage remains floating rectangular supports/step routes. The new resource relation has more gameplay content, but not yet evidence of finished spatial composition or human enjoyment.
issues.falsifiable_repair: Review silhouette/negative space and observational flow separately from the proven causal sequence; no automatic art/fun approval.

samples.technical_status: Root reports known moderate robustness failures under repair; this review does not override that result
